_default:
Original game, made by us (own HTML5 engine bundled in the app, WKWebView, everything runs offline from the app bundle: no downloaded or remote content, no account, no login).
Third-party services: Google AdMob (Google UMP consent form shown first, then Apple's ATT prompt; ads only between games and optional rewarded videos) and StoreKit 2 for in-app purchases.
How to test: tap Play; the first-launch tutorial can be skipped (Skip, top right) and replayed in Settings. Shop: cart icon on the home screen. Restore purchases and Ad choices: Settings. The "No ads" purchase removes interstitial ads.
No random item can be bought with real money; all chances are shown in the game.
Languages: French and English.
braise:
Original game, made by us (own HTML5 engine bundled in the app, WKWebView, offline, no account, no ads, no third-party SDK, no data collected).
Changes since the rejection of 19 November 2026 (guideline 2.3.3): all screenshots and the app preview were re-captured from real gameplay on iPhone (harvesting, fire, hunting, night), with no title screen or menus; a short first-launch tutorial was added (skippable, replayable from the Pause menu).
How to test: start a new game and follow the tutorial; the game is fully playable without any purchase.
Languages: 29, including French and English.
